The '''Talisman of the Brackaset''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Talisman of Transformation]]. It allowed the wearer to [[Metamorphosis|take the shape]] of a [[brackaset]]. ''[[Wild Power]]'', [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] short manual, made a passing mention of this artifact.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
